title: DeepSeek Harness: A Systems Dissection
description: A source-pinned, module-by-module architectural study of DeepSeek Harness

chapters.title: Reading Guide and Research Map
chapters.subtitle: How to navigate the study, current progress, and the complete question space
chapters.scope: Define the site structure, completion criteria, reading paths, and research boundaries.

chapters.title: Baseline, Method, and Evidence Rules
chapters.subtitle: Separating source facts, mechanism-level deductions, and design assessments
chapters.scope: Pin the upstream commit and define evidence strength, stable citations, and completion gates.

chapters.title: Design Philosophy
chapters.subtitle: The runtime worldview behind “everything is a plugin”
chapters.scope: Analyze the replaceable core, reversible effects, composition-first design, explicit boundaries, and event sourcing.

chapters.title: An Atlas of 219 Packages
chapters.subtitle: Package groups, roles, dependency direction, and runtime placement
chapters.scope: Enumerate every workspace package and classify definitions, providers, consumers, surfaces, and infrastructure.

chapters.title: Boot, Profiles, Bundles, and Configuration Layers
chapters.subtitle: How a running dsh process is composed into an ordered plugin tree
chapters.scope: Trace the CLI into Loader, profile and bundle patch order, isolation domains, replacement semantics, and disposal.

chapters.title: Agent Objects, Registry, and Lifecycle
chapters.subtitle: Creation, resumption, inboxes, state, and shutdown
chapters.scope: Trace the Agent interface, registry, create/resume transactions, live handles, initiators, and cancellation semantics.

chapters.title: The Turn / Step / Loop State Machine
chapters.subtitle: From input claims through model calls and tools to turn stop points
chapters.scope: Trace durable turns, steps, waterfalls, empty steps, failures, and next-step input branch by branch.

chapters.title: Prompt Assembly and Context Injection
chapters.subtitle: Section registry, ordering, scope, tool schemas, and dynamic context
chapters.scope: Analyze the system-prompt registry, section ordering, per-step rebuilds, agent.inject, and context plugins.

chapters.title: LLM Adapters and Conversation Protocol Translation
chapters.subtitle: How internal messages project into DeepSeek, Pi AI, and replay adapters
chapters.scope: Analyze internal messages and streams, adapter registration and selection, tool calls, reasoning, usage, and error normalization.

chapters.title: Internal Sessions and the Event Model
chapters.subtitle: How append-only SessionEvents become the source of truth for model context
chapters.scope: Catalog envelopes, event types, sequence numbers, scopes, origin links, format versions, and model-visible invariants.

chapters.title: Logs, Derived History, Replay, and Forking
chapters.subtitle: From raw chunks to reconstructable model input and UI state
chapters.scope: Trace append, deriveMessages, raw chunks, fork boundaries, resume, transcripts, and replay fidelity.

chapters.title: Persistence and Database Design
chapters.subtitle: JSONL, SQLite, generic Storage, and data ownership
chapters.scope: Analyze session persistence, SQLite schemas and migrations, JSONL, KV storage, domain forms, attachments, and workspaces.

chapters.title: Projections, Checkpoints, and Cold Start
chapters.subtitle: Which disposable acceleration state exists beyond the complete event log
chapters.scope: Distinguish semantic checkpoints, projection caches, watermarks, write-behind, tail replay, and recovery thresholds.

chapters.title: Compaction and Context Pressure
chapters.subtitle: The distinct semantics of tool-result pruning, summary replacement, and overflow recovery
chapters.scope: Verify compaction levels, triggers, token metering, pruners, summaries, surface generation, manual compaction, and failure recovery.

chapters.title: Memory and Knowledge: Capabilities and Deliberate Omissions
chapters.subtitle: Boundaries among session logs, summaries, skills, session query, and long-term semantic memory
chapters.scope: Separate working context, durable logs, session references, query, skills, and genuine cross-session memory.

chapters.title: Plan, Goal, and Todo
chapters.subtitle: Three similar-looking primitives with different lifecycles
chapters.scope: Analyze logged plan mode, goal revisions and continuation, todo projections, permissions, and UI presentation.

chapters.title: Tool Definition Primitives and the Execution Pipeline
chapters.subtitle: Schemas, scope, execution modes, presentation, and waterfalls
chapters.scope: Dissect ToolDefinition, registry snapshots, pre/guard/around/post/finalize/result, and Code Mode subcalls.

chapters.title: Complete Tool Catalog and Capability Taxonomy
chapters.subtitle: Inputs, outputs, policy, and UI intent for every model-visible tool
chapters.scope: Enumerate tool names, provider packages, schemas, parallel modes, risk surfaces, and backend seams from generated catalogs and source.

chapters.title: Tool Parallelism and Result Ordering
chapters.subtitle: Barriers, rolling windows, reclassification, and model-order settlement
chapters.scope: Trace executionMode classification, concurrency pools, barriers, pre-start reclassification, settlement, and additional-context ordering.

chapters.title: Permission Analysis, Approval, and Monotonic Guards
chapters.subtitle: Who proposes risk, who may permit, and who may only deny
chapters.scope: Analyze pre-execute policy, approval waterfalls, fail-closed absence, monotonic guards, presets, and per-call authorization.

chapters.title: Sandbox, Filesystem, and Observation Policy
chapters.subtitle: How processes and files share one execution world and root policy
chapters.scope: Analyze sandbox seams and backends, policy, filesystem providers, write/edit intent, read-before-edit, E2B, and cross-platform behavior.

chapters.title: Shell, PTY, Terminal, and Background Jobs
chapters.subtitle: Short-lived processes, persistent sessions, retained output, and ownership
chapters.scope: Trace subprocesses, shell executors, terminal ownership, job registries, spill, signals, and kill escalation.

chapters.title: Web, LSP, MCP, and Skills
chapters.subtitle: Stable tool names, replaceable providers, and progressive capability disclosure
chapters.scope: Analyze web-provider registries, LSP normalization, MCP client mounting, skill catalog/load, and prompt exposure.

chapters.title: Code Mode, Self-Modification, and Dynamic Plugins
chapters.subtitle: How the model orchestrates tools and can inspect or mount its own runtime
chapters.scope: Analyze run_code transport, worker runtimes, serialized subcalls, Cordis inspect/define, VM boundaries, and disposal.

chapters.title: Multi-Agent Coordination
chapters.subtitle: In-process, fork, ACP, Codex, Claude Code, and SDK backends behind one seam
chapters.scope: Analyze provider registries, spawn/fork, context inheritance, continuation activation, controls, reporting, and job integration.

chapters.title: Workflow and Ralph
chapters.subtitle: How model-authored JavaScript orchestration bridges to Agent calls
chapters.scope: Analyze the worker-thread engine, agent() bridge, fan-out, aggregation, events, errors, and the fixed Ralph loop.

chapters.title: Inbox, Steering, and Continuation
chapters.subtitle: How mid-run input is queued, claimed, injected, or routed to child Agents
chapters.scope: Analyze message classes, wake and next-step behavior, claims, steer, follow-up, activation, and turn boundaries.

chapters.title: Retries, Errors, Cancellation, and Recovery
chapters.subtitle: Which layer owns the decision when failures cross different boundaries
chapters.scope: Analyze provider retry, request-error recovery, tool timeouts, abort, cleanup, misconfiguration, and crash-safe persistence.

chapters.title: Observability, Telemetry, and Trajectories
chapters.subtitle: The division of labor among event logs, projections, redaction, OTel, and UI traces
chapters.scope: Analyze session telemetry capture/redaction/handoff, OTel logs, stats, trace query, raw events, and operational logs.

chapters.title: API, SDK, JSON-RPC, and ACP
chapters.subtitle: How browsers, automation, and external clients drive the same Agent runtime
chapters.scope: Analyze Host remotes, Typert, WebSocket, stdio SDK, ACP mappings, event subscriptions, and protocol-boundary validation.

chapters.title: The Web UI Plugin Architecture
chapters.subtitle: Client-side Cordis, slots, SessionRuntime, and conversation projections
chapters.scope: Analyze dual host/browser plugins, module loading, slots, conversation nodes, tool presentation, reconnects, and state ownership.

chapters.title: Security Model and Trust Boundaries
chapters.subtitle: How a local Agent product constrains broad execution with explicit policy
chapters.scope: Build a threat model spanning configuration trust, model input, tool JSON, approval, sandboxes, paths, credentials, remotes, and self-modification.

chapters.title: Tests, Snapshots, and Runtime Invariants
chapters.subtitle: How the system proves that plugin composition still satisfies its semantics
chapters.scope: Analyze the 100% per-file gate, keyless snapshots, invariant registries, generated-document checks, configuration closure, and platform matrices.

chapters.title: Strengths, Costs, and Design Tradeoffs
chapters.subtitle: Which complexity buys real composability, and which complexity remains debt
chapters.scope: Synthesize only from verified chapters instead of repeating the project’s own claims.

chapters.title: Gaps, Limitations, and Open Questions
chapters.subtitle: Semantics and evidence that remain incomplete during Developer Preview
chapters.scope: Record missing behavior, weak guarantees, documentation/code drift, platform differences, and required runtime experiments.

chapters.title: Glossary, Evidence Catalog, and Source Index
chapters.subtitle: Navigate from concepts and claims back to the pinned source baseline
chapters.scope: Collect terminology, every evidence record, package/symbol/event indexes, and citation coverage.
